CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blends the tunnel pass back into the final image; higher values increase feedback/ghosting.
CONTROLS.NAME: composition_feedback

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Enables bass-reactive party effects (glitchy horizontal offsets and kal/offset mixing) on strong hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: party_boi

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Base surface color; shader also mixes in its complement to create contrast.
CONTROLS.NAME: color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Pushes the material toward a flat, single-hue version of the base color (less complementary blending).
CONTROLS.NAME: monochrome

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Tint for the rave glow/fog overlay; visible when rave mode is active.
CONTROLS.NAME: glow_color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Engages the rave post-FX: edge/vibrance mix and glow fog (dampened when media is shown/bass-mixed).
CONTROLS.NAME: rave_mode

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Flips the mask used for the edge effect, swapping inside/outside weighting.
CONTROLS.NAME: invert_mask

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls Sobel edge thickness/strength in the rave post-FX stage.
CONTROLS.NAME: mask_edge

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mixes the media texture into the material shading when media is available.
CONTROLS.NAME: show_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of media UV displacement applied in shading.
CONTROLS.NAME: media_displace

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Drives media displacement automatically from audio presence instead of the slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_displace

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mixes media by bass presence rather than the manual show_media amount.
CONTROLS.NAME: media_bass

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mixes media by bass presence rather than the manual show_media amount.
CONTROLS.NAME: media_under

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rounds cell corners toward dots across all tiles (higher = rounder).
CONTROLS.NAME: all_dots

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds beat-driven randomness to the dot rounding so cells pop toward circles on hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: wave_dots

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scales the maximum extrusion height of tiles and the z-warp amount (when not spectrum-driven).
CONTROLS.NAME: max_height

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blends the tile height toward the audio spectrum (blue band) for audio-reactive extrusion.
CONTROLS.NAME: use_audio_spectrum

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of negative-space patches that flatten the wave field inside cells.
CONTROLS.NAME: patches

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Average patch size/density threshold for the negative-space mask.
CONTROLS.NAME: patch_size

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Drives the patch amount from bass presence instead of the patches slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_patches

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Drives patch size from mid-band presence instead of the patch_size slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_size

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Switches the wave-type selection to be beat-driven instead of using the square_wave toggle.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_square

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically flattens wave troughs based on audio presence rather than the flat_trough slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_flat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manually selects the box-pattern wave (on) vs radial wave (off) when beat_square is disabled.
CONTROLS.NAME: square_wave

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Flattens the wave troughs (raises minima) to create more plateaued heights.
CONTROLS.NAME: flat_trough

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls ripple/cell travel speed where implemented in host logic.
CONTROLS.NAME: ripple_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Enables beat-based boost logic for ripple features where implemented.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_boost

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Camera zoom: increases ray forward component for a tighter FOV.
CONTROLS.NAME: zoom

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Drives camera zoom automatically from audio/random beat pulses instead of the slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_zoom

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When auto zooming, uses random beat values to create zoom pops on hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_zoom

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automates camera tilt using audio presence/beat instead of manual angles.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_tilt

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When tilting automatically, favors beat-randomized tilt over smooth time sway.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_tilt

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manual camera tilt: X rotates the view in screen space; Y pitches the ray setup before tracing.
CONTROLS.NAME: tilt_angle

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blends in a spherical/tunnel direction field to morph the camera rays.
CONTROLS.NAME: morph

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls morph animation speed where used by host (affects morph_time).
CONTROLS.NAME: morph_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automates morph amount from high-order bass presence instead of the slider.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_morph

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Enables forward layer travel with z-tiling, creating an endless field.
CONTROLS.NAME: layer_travel

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of layer travel where implemented in host logic (affects layer_time).
CONTROLS.NAME: travel_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically oscillates between left/right vertical mirrors based on presence.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_mir

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manual mirror blend between the two vertical mirror variants.
CONTROLS.NAME: mir

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets beat-rise to auto from overall audio presence, overriding manual beat delay.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_beat_rise

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Time between randomized effect changes; effective wait ≈ 1.0/value seconds.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_delay
